title: ServiceLog CSP Service Metadata
description: Canonical machine-readable contract for CSP-owned service metadata YAML. CSP teams (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) own the values in each document; the ServiceLog/platform team owns this schema -- field definitions, required/optional rules, and controlled vocabularies. A document that does not conform must fail validation rather than be silently accepted, reinterpreted, or coerced.

name.description: Stable machine-readable identifier for this service. Lowercase kebab-case. Must be unique across the entire loaded catalog (enforced at catalog build time, not per-document).

title.description: Human-readable service name shown in ServiceLog.

owner.description: Backstage Catalog ownership reference (group/user). This is Backstage-integration metadata, NOT the ServiceLog accountable person -- see spec.profile.serviceOwner for that. Optional in prototype data when the real owner is not yet known; never invent a value to populate this field.

lifecycle.description: Backstage Catalog lifecycle stage. Backstage metadata, not consumed by the ServiceLog UI.

cloudProvider.description: Controlled vocabulary: the CSP that owns this service. Adding a new provider requires a schema change, not a new string value in a YAML document.

serviceCategory.description: Controlled vocabulary: the V1 ServiceLog category list. Spelling variants of an existing category (e.g. 'AI and Machine Learning' vs 'AI & Machine Learning') are rejected rather than silently creating a new category.

cloudAto.description: Controlled vocabulary: Cloud Authority to Operate designation.

trmStatus.description: Controlled vocabulary: Technical Reference Model status. Exactly these four values -- an unrecognized value (e.g. 'Dangerous') must fail validation, never be coerced into one of these.

fundingApproach.description: Controlled vocabulary: how provisioning of this service is funded.

approvalWorkflow.description: Controlled vocabulary: the approval workflow required to provision this service.

serviceLogProfile.description: ServiceLog-facing metadata. Every field here normalizes into the stable Service UI contract (src/app/data/types.ts) -- no additional or renamed fields are permitted without a contract change.

cloudAto.description: Array to preserve the future multi-select model, even though the current dataset carries exactly one value per service.

serviceOwner.description: ServiceLog accountable person. Distinct from spec.owner (Backstage Catalog ownership) and from trmRestrictionOwner (a group, only for Restricted services).

trmRestrictionOwner.description: Jira/Outlook-style group, required only when trmStatus is Restricted.

serviceOnboardingRequirements.description: Clean requirement strings. Legacy hover-tooltip HTML markup must not appear here.
